mech_source.name: pidigits.mec
mech_source.code:
<state> := <{k<u64>, count<u64>, n<u64>, q<bigint>, r<bigint>, t<bigint>, scratch<bigint>}>
Extract(s<state>, j<u64>) = (digit<u64>) :=
  product := bigint/multiply-u64-into(s.scratch, s.q, j)
  numerator := bigint/add-into(product, product, s.r)
  digit := bigint/floor-u64(numerator, s.t).
Label(count<u64>) => <u64> := io/print("\t:{}\n", count)
NoLabel(count<u64>) => <u64> := 0
More(s<state>) => <bool> := s.count < s.n
Produce(s<state>, digit<u64>) = (next<state>) :=
  remainder := bigint/subtract-multiple-u64(s.r, s.t, digit)
  r := bigint/multiply-u64-into(remainder, remainder, 10)
  q := bigint/multiply-u64-into(s.q, s.q, 10)
  output := io/print("{}", digit)
  label := control/if(number/mod(s.count + 1, 10) == 0, Label, NoLabel, s.count + 1)
  next := {k: s.k, count: s.count + 1, n: s.n, q: q, r: r, t: s.t, scratch: s.scratch}.
Consume(s<state>, digit<u64>) = (next<state>) :=
  numerator := bigint/add-multiple-u64(s.r, s.q, 2)
  r := bigint/multiply-u64-into(numerator, numerator, 2 * s.k + 1)
  q := bigint/multiply-u64-into(s.q, s.q, s.k)
  t := bigint/multiply-u64-into(s.t, s.t, 2 * s.k + 1)
  next := {k: s.k + 1, count: s.count, n: s.n, q: q, r: r, t: t, scratch: s.scratch}.
Step(s<state>) = (next<state>) :=
  first := Extract(s, 3)
  second := Extract(s, 4)
  next := control/if(first == second, Produce, Consume, (s, first)).
NeedsSpace(column<u64>) => <bool> := column < 10
Space(column<u64>) = (next<u64>) :=
  output := io/print(" ")
  next := column + 1.
Finish(count<u64>) = (done<u64>) :=
  column := control/while(number/mod(count, 10), NeedsSpace, Space)
  done := Label(count).
initial := {k: 1, count: 0, n: io/argument-u64(1), q: bigint/new(1), r: bigint/new(0), t: bigint/new(1), scratch: bigint/new(0)}
state := control/while(initial, More, Step)
finished := control/if(number/mod(state.count, 10) != 0, Finish, NoLabel, state.count)

mech_source.name: regexredux.mec
mech_source.code:
Count(dna<string>, pattern<string>) = (line<string>) :=
  count := regex/count-bytes(dna, pattern)
  line := string/concat(string/concat(pattern, " "), string/concat(number/format(count, 0), "\n")).
raw := io/read()
initial := text/length(raw)
dna := raw |> regex/replace-bytes(_, ">[^\n]*\n|\n", "")
cleaned := text/length(dna)
io/write(Count(dna, "agggtaaa|tttaccct"))
io/write(Count(dna, "[cgt]gggtaaa|tttaccc[acg]"))
io/write(Count(dna, "a[act]ggtaaa|tttacc[agt]t"))
io/write(Count(dna, "ag[act]gtaaa|tttac[agt]ct"))
io/write(Count(dna, "agg[act]taaa|ttta[agt]cct"))
io/write(Count(dna, "aggg[acg]aaa|ttt[cgt]ccct"))
io/write(Count(dna, "agggt[cgt]aa|tt[acg]accct"))
io/write(Count(dna, "agggta[cgt]a|t[acg]taccct"))
io/write(Count(dna, "agggtaa[cgt]|[acg]ttaccct"))
four := dna |> regex/replace-bytes(_, "tHa[Nt]", "<4>")
three := four |> regex/replace-bytes(_, "aND|caN|Ha[DS]|WaS", "<3>")
two := three |> regex/replace-bytes(_, "a[NSt]|BY", "<2>")
bars := two |> regex/replace-bytes(_, "<[^>]*>", "|")
final := bars |> regex/replace-bytes(_, "\\|[^|][^|]*\\|", "-")
io/write(string/concat("\n", string/concat(number/format(initial, 0), "\n")))
io/write(string/concat(number/format(cleaned, 0), "\n"))
io/write(string/concat(number/format(text/length(final), 0), "\n"))

mech_source.name: fasta.mec
mech_source.code:
More(lo<u64>, hi<u64>, r<f64>, p<[f64]>) => <bool> := lo + 1 < hi
Search(lo<u64>, hi<u64>, r<f64>, p<[f64]>) = (low<u64>, high<u64>, random<f64>, probabilities<[f64]>) :=
  mid := (lo + hi) / 2
  left := r < sequence/get(p, mid)
  low := control/select(left, lo, mid)
  high := control/select(left, mid, hi)
  random := r
  probabilities := p.
Choose(r<f64>, p<[f64]>, alphabet<[u8]>) = (byte<u64>) :=
  (lo, hi, random, probabilities) := control/while((0, sequence/length(p), r, p), More, Search)
  byte := sequence/get(alphabet, hi).
Repeat(index<u64>) = (next<u64>, byte<u64>) :=
  alu := bytes/from-text("GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGGGAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGATCACCTGAGGTCAGGAGTTCGAGACCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACTAAAAATACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCGTGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCAGCTACTCGGGAGGCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGGAGGCGGAGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCGCCACTGCACTCCAGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA")
  byte := sequence/get(alu, index + 1)
  next := number/mod(index + 1, sequence/length(alu)).
Iub(seed<u64>) = (next<u64>, byte<u64>) :=
  next := number/mod(seed * 3877 + 29573, 139968)
  r := number/to-f64(next) / 139968.0
  p := sequence/cumulative-sum(sequence/f64-values((0.27, 0.12, 0.12, 0.27, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02)))
  byte := Choose(r, p, bytes/from-text("acgtBDHKMNRSVWY")).
Human(seed<u64>) = (next<u64>, byte<u64>) :=
  next := number/mod(seed * 3877 + 29573, 139968)
  r := number/to-f64(next) / 139968.0
  p := sequence/cumulative-sum(sequence/f64-values((0.3029549426680, 0.1979883004921, 0.1975473066391, 0.3015094502008)))
  byte := Choose(r, p, bytes/from-text("acgt")).
n := number/bounded(io/argument-u64(1), 0, 1844674407370955161)
io/write(">ONE Homo sapiens alu\n")
repeat := io/write-scan(n * 2, 0, Repeat, 60, "\n", 65536)
io/write(">TWO IUB ambiguity codes\n")
seed := io/write-scan(n * 3, 42, Iub, 60, "\n", 65536)
io/write(">THREE Homo sapiens frequency\n")
last := io/write-scan(n * 5, seed, Human, 60, "\n", 65536)
